exitMessage: Light, then cold stone. You wake on the altar of a vast cathedral.

barks.speaker: falcon
barks.text: Get behind me. NOW.

barks.speaker: alpha
barks.text: There you are, old bird. Hiding your little heroes up in the clouds.

barks.speaker: falcon
barks.text: ...Alpha. That's impossible. The Emperors don't come here. They never come here.

barks.speaker: alpha
barks.text: Another one of his gifts. Show me what he gave you.

barks.speaker: falcon
barks.text: Stay behind me! Whatever happens, don't try to be a hero.

barks.speaker: alpha
barks.text: Sit down, Falcon. This isn't your dance.

barks.speaker: falcon
barks.text: Kid... move! Keep moving!

barks.speaker: falcon
barks.text: Watch her hands, not the light. Slip through the gaps!

barks.speaker: alpha
barks.text: Is this what he sends now? You barely flicker.

barks.speaker: you
barks.text: Nothing I throw even touches her...

barks.speaker: alpha
barks.text: Dance for me a little longer.

barks.speaker: falcon
barks.text: Don't let her corner you against the rocks!

barks.speaker: alpha
barks.text: He always did choose the stubborn ones.

barks.speaker: alpha
barks.text: Enough playing.

barks.speaker: alpha
barks.text: Hold still.

barks.speaker: falcon
barks.text: No-!

barks.speaker: falcon
barks.text: Agh... that one... was meant for you.

barks.speaker: falcon
barks.text: Listen to me. I can't stop her. But I can still send you somewhere safe. The nearest Cathedral.

barks.speaker: alpha
barks.text: You're spending the last of yourself on a stranger?

barks.speaker: falcon
barks.text: Remember what I told you. Keep your eyes... open...

barks.speaker: alpha
barks.text: Run, then. I'll find you again.
